from state import Config

def test_set_invalidates_cache():
    c = Config()
    assert c.get("a") is None
    c.set("a", 1)
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    c.set("a", 2)
    assert c.get("a") == 2

def test_default_not_sticky():
    c = Config()
    assert c.get("a", 5) == 5
    c.set("a", 7)
    assert c.get("a") == 7


from collect import unique_append

def test_unique_leak():
    first = unique_append([], 7)
    second = unique_append([], 7)
    assert first == [7]
    assert second == [7]

def test_unique_duplicate_in_list():
    assert unique_append([1], 1, {1}) == [1]
